help.title: Help & Support
help.introText: Thank you for using our local AI chat application. This help section will guide you through all the features and help you get the most out of your experience.
help.gettingStartedText: To start using the application, simply select a model, choose a profile, and start chatting! The AI will respond in the language you've selected for the interface.
help.profilesDescription: Profiles allow you to customize the AI's behavior. Each profile has different settings for temperature, creativity, and response style.
help.modelsDescription: Different AI models have different capabilities. Smaller models are faster but less powerful, while larger models provide better quality but need more resources.
help.chatDescription: Here you can have conversations with the AI. Type your message or use voice input, and the AI will respond accordingly.
help.voiceInputDescription: Click the microphone button to use speech-to-text. Make sure to allow microphone permissions in your browser.
help.languageDescription: The AI will automatically respond in the language you've selected for the interface (English or German).
help.tip1: Use clear and specific questions for better answers
help.tip2: For complex topics, break them down into smaller questions
help.tip3: Experiment with different profiles to find your preferred AI personality
help.tip4: Larger models provide better quality but may be slower on less powerful devices
help.contactSupport: If you need further assistance, please check our documentation or contact support.
